fixture: pnpm e2e:serve --plugin=docs/pr-assets/issue-340-settings-outside-slots/mnemon-settings-embed-fixture. The test-only plugin adds a 插件配置 Settings section that mirrors the dsh-mnemon plugins.bundle.config entry (component, locale, inject) into a slot of its own and renders it there with view: page. The mirrored entry declares no children, so DSH passes it no renderSlot. The baseline is this branch with main's versions of the client files the fix changes, since main's serve-e2e.mjs has no --plugin= flag.
procedure: Open Plugins, then the dsh-mnemon page; list the gears of the composition board.
Open Settings, then 插件配置; list the gears of the same board.
Open the gears of 运行时记忆, 记忆空间 and 分层策略 from the Settings section, and 分层策略 from the Plugins page.
